- `packages/mcp/package.json` (`@objectstack/lint` moves from `devDependencies` to `dependencies`: the tool now calls lint's shared entry at runtime; no cycle, since lint depends only on formula, metadata-core, sdui-parser and spec, and runtime and cli already depend on lint at runtime) and the matching `pnpm-lock.yaml` move;
- the two mcp bridge-member ledgers (tripwire `RECIPES`, stdio `BRIDGE_MEMBERS`) and two `packages/runtime` test files (ADR-0106 mask table, bridge read pin), because both bridges gain one optional member `servedObjectDefinitionOf` (the same caller-scoped read `describeObject` uses).

Design as reported by the card thread: lint exports one entry that runs the gate's own `runStackExpressionPasses` on a one-rule (or one-field) stack built from the served definitions, with the shared validator call left out through a new option that every gate run leaves absent, so every gate pass at both sites is carried by construction; an enumeration pin scans the gate's source at both sites. Everything else in the claim stands.
